subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: The Pramukh Swami Maharaj Amrut Mahotsav begins in Mumbai
story: On this day in 1995, the 37 day Amrut Mahotsav for Pramukh Swami Maharaj's 75th birthday began in Mumbai, later welcoming over 8.1 million visitors.

items.text:
The 37-day festival, that began on 25 November, hosted Pramukh Swami
Maharaj’s 75th birthday celebrations and attracted over 8.1 million
visitors from around the world. The festival brought India’s culture to life
through its beautiful folk dances, intricate architecture, and vibrant music.

options.headline: Pramukh Swami Maharaj performs murti pratishtha at the new mandir in Dholka
options.story: On this day, Pramukh Swami Maharaj performed the murti pratishtha of the newly built BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Dholka, Gujarat. The mandir's inauguration was Swamishri's 15th shikharbaddh mandir inauguration. Bhagwan Swaminarayan, Gunatitanand Swami and the paramhansas had sanctified the land of Dholka.
options.whatsapp: On this day in 2001, Pramukh Swami Maharaj consecrated the new BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir in Dholka, his 15th shikharbaddh mandir inauguration.

options.headline: Going for Thakorji's darshan
options.story:
At 5.20 pm Swamishri departed from Gandhinagar and arrived in Bochasan at around 7.00 pm. Swamishri arrived on stage for the volunteers’ assembly. The assembly of over 7,000 volunteers was charged by Swamishri’s presence. Swamishri was honoured by the senior sadhus, and thereafter he addressed the volunteers, “We are all very fortunate and blessed to have got the service of the BAPS Centenary Celebration. Shastriji Maharaj built a mandir here in Bochasan and consecrated the murtis of Akshar and Purushottam. He came on earth at Maharaj’s behest and first established this principle in Bochasan. Since that historic day 100 years have passed so quickly. We are blessed to celebrate this occasion today. May all of you serve with enthusiasm and satisfy the thousands of devotees who will come to the festival.”

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.

19 November 2006, Gandhinagar

About 20 family members of the Shayona group and devotees from Amdavad pilgrimaged 25 km from Amdavad to Gandhinagar.

Also, 85 students pilgrimaged from Pethapur, 20 devotees walked from Sardhav (20 km) and several children walked 4 km from Gandhinagar Sectors 23 and 18.

20 November 2006, Gandhinagar

Eight BAPS teenagers cycled 25 km from Kalol.

Thirteen women devotees performed Swaminarayan mantra jaap while walking from Gandhinagar sectors 5, 13, 7 and 14.

Fourteen devotees pilgrimaged 7 km by foot.

Twenty women devotees pilgrimaged by foot from Sectors 3, 4, 6, Kirtidham and Hari Nagar.

21 November 2006, Gandhinagar

Sixty-two devotees and children pilgrimaged 25 km by foot from Kalol,

11 women devotees from GEB walked 7 km,

10 women devotees walked 10 km from Vavol,

14 women devotees walked from Sector 29.

Forty-two women devotees and 37 children walked 7 km from Sector 27, and 30 women devotees chanted Janmangal Namavali while they walked from sector 2.

A woman devotee chanted Janmangal Namavali 25 times, performed 208 panchang pranams and did 11 malas.

Fourteen devotees pilgrimaged by foot from Nardipur village in Kalol region.

Thirty women devotees walked from Sectors 1, 2, 7 and 8.

Raghavbhai Bharatbhai performed dandvats from Sector 21.

Bhavik Bharat Patel of ninth grade performed 525 dandvats.

Jiten Parmar, a child, chanted Janmangal Namavali 21 times and observed a liquid fast.

Thirteen- and fourteen-year-olds Punam Parmar, Alpesh and Sanjay performed dandvats for 4½ km from Pethapur.

Ashok Patel pilgrimaged by foot.

Gautam Patel, Jivraj Patel, Gambhirji Mistry of Gandhinagar pilgrimaged by foot from Amdavad mandir.

22 November 2006, Gandhinagar

Women devotees pilgrimaged 24 km by foot from Mansa.

For Swamishri’s good health 50 women devotees observed waterless fasts.

Kiranben Mehta pilgrimaged 6 km by foot daily from Sector 24.

Gajendrasinh Bihola walked 45 km from Vijapur.

Devotees pilgrimaged 24 km by foot from Mansa and Sector 24.

23 November 2006, Gandhinagar

Six males, eight females and two children pilgrimaged 18 km by foot from Khoraj in Koba region, and five devotees from Navapura.

Eight women devotees walked 7 km from Sector 5.

The Gandhinagar yuvati mandal performed 12 hours of mala jap – totally doing 21,786 malas.

Three women devotees pilgrimaged by foot and chanted the Swaminarayan mantra from GEB.

27 November 2006, Gandhinagar

Swamishri blessed 186 children students of Swaminarayan Vidyalay, Sarangpur, for pilgrimaging by foot from Sarangpur.

Thirty-three youths pilgrimaged by running 486 km in relay from Junagadh.

28 November 2006, Gandhinagar

Twenty-one devotees of Devgadh Bariya region pilgrimaged 150 km by foot.

Ten devotees and seven youths of Rabod region pilgrimaged 150 km by foot.

Thirty youths pilgrimaged 150 km by foot from Panchmahal, Lunavada and Naroda.

Going for Thakorji's darshan. Blesses the patotsav assembly. Performs puja of Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj Shri Hanumanji and other 11 new hari mandirs. Is honored with garlands. Was honored with garlands by senior sadhus. Blesses the murti-pratishtha assembly. In happy, divine mood. Blesses sadhus for having written thesis in Sanskrit on the Upanishads and Bhagwad Gita. Blesses the assembly. During the assembly. In a happy, divine mood after the pratishtha rituals. Pujan of Brahmaswarup Shri Pragji Bhakta. Observes the renovated murtis of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj for the 100th anniversary(patotsav) of Bochasan mandir. Blesses a bhakta. Performs murti-pratishtha of Shri Nilkanth Varni. Bapa and guests perform the yagna arti. Engaged in Thakorji's darshan. Performs murti-pratishtha of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj. Humbly bows, accepting the love and respect of all, and conveys Jai Swaminarayan. Pujan of Shri Harikrishna Maharaj and Shri Lakshmi Narayan Dev. In humble prayer and engaged in darshan of Thakorji. Observes paintings of Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Shastriji Maharaj placed in the mandir dome. Holds kalash as part of the yagna rituals. Performs pujan of Shri Ghanshyam Maharaj as part of the murti-pratishtha ritual. Performs pradakshina at the shrine of Shri Purushottamdasji. Arrives for his morning puja. In the renovated open mandir pradakshina. Engaged in a discussion in the mandir pradakshina. Performs Nyas vidhi of Shri Akshar Purushottam Maharaj. Bapa and senior sadhus hail the BAPS flag to mark the launching of BAPS Centenary Celebration. Blesses the grandson of Keshavlal Shukla (who chanted the mantras for the murti-pratishtha rituals 100 years ago in Bochasan in the presence of Shastriji Maharaj) who conducted and chanted mantras of the murti-pratishtha ritual. Bows to all bhaktas on his arrival. On the assembly stage. Blesses the yagna participants. Hails jai of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Sanctifies the new bell by ringing it. Lights the lamp to mark the launching of BAPS Centenary Celebration. Arrives in the evening satsang assembly. Arrives onto the yagna mandap stage. In humble prayer before Shri Nilkanth Varni. Pujan of Brahmaswarup Shri Yogiji Maharaj. Performs patotsav mahapuja. Performs patotsav arti.
